title: The Wind That Came and Went
intro: This quiz follows two curious kids at the beach as they discover how sea breezes and land breezes form.

questions.explanation: A breeze is a gentle, pleasant wind.

questions.prompt: During the day, which heats up faster?
questions.explanation: During the day, the land heats up faster than the sea.

questions.prompt: In which direction does a sea breeze blow?
choices: From the land to the sea
From the sea to the land
From the sky to the ground
questions.explanation: A sea breeze blows from the sea to the land.

questions.prompt: What happens to the air above the sea at night?
questions.explanation: At night, the air above the sea becomes warmer and rises.

choices: Warm air sinks and cool air rises
Warm air rises and cool air moves in to replace it
questions.explanation: Wind begins when warm air rises and cool air moves in to replace it.
